name: Keio University
description: Keio University is a private university in Tokyo, founded in 1858 by Fukuzawa Yukichi and Japan's oldest institution of modern higher education. It has ten undergraduate faculties spanning the humanities, social sciences, science and technology, and medicine.
whyIncluded: Keio offers two all-English undergraduate degree programmes (PEARL (Programme in Economics for Alliances, Research and Leadership) in the Faculty of Economics and GIGA (Global Information and Governance Academic Program) at its Shonan Fujisawa Campus), the Public Service Commission places scholars in Japan, and Japan is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 270 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: Keio's own sample monthly budget for an international student off campus near its Shonan Fujisawa campus, 12 months a year. Excludes insurance; central Tokyo campuses likely cost more.
livingCosts.notes: Keio SFC (Shonan Fujisawa Campus) housing page, 'Off-campus Housing Example (per month)' for international students, total ¥145,000: housing = rent ¥60,000 + utilities/internet ¥15,000; food ¥30,000; transport ¥10,000; personal = phone ¥5,000 + books ¥5,000 + hobbies ¥7,000 + others ¥10,000. Insurance ¥3,000 excluded. The page is undated (read 2026-09-30) and says students should budget about ¥120,000-150,000 a month; Mita/Yagami campuses in central Tokyo are likely dearer.

programmes.name: Faculty of Science and Technology
programmes.summary: First-year fees for all students. Compulsory fees cover registration and facilities plus lab fees. The one-off ¥200,000 is the admission fee, paid once in year 1. Fees rise yearly. Taught in Japanese.
programmes.notes: AY 2026 Academic Fees and Expenses for Undergraduate Faculties (first-year row). Tuition = 授業料. Compulsory fees = registration fee ¥70,000 + facilities fee ¥260,000 + experiment/practical training fee ¥120,000 + student government fee ¥750 + health mutual-aid ¥2,600 (includes a ¥100 one-time registration). One-off = admission fee ¥200,000. Registration, tuition, facilities and lab fees rise yearly on a sliding scale, so not cohort-locked. Japanese-taught; the English-taught International Graduate Programs are at master's level. 2025 figures from the AY 2025 undergraduate fee table (Japanese): tuition ¥1,390,000, facilities ¥250,000 + lab ¥120,000, other fees ¥3,350. 2024 figures from the AY 2024 undergraduate fee table (English, Nov 2023 announcement): tuition ¥1,340,000, registration ¥60,000, facilities ¥250,000 + lab ¥110,000, other fees ¥3,350, admission ¥200,000.

programmes.summary: Annual fees for the 3-year Japanese-taught law degree for the Japanese bar (2 years with a law degree). The one-off ¥100,000 is the admission fee, paid in year 1. Fees rise yearly.
programmes.notes: AY 2026 Law School Professional Degree Programs fee table, 2026 entrants row (1年･未修; the 2-year track for law graduates has the same annual fees). Tuition = 授業料 ¥1,220,000. Compulsory fees = registration fee (在籍料) ¥330,000 + facilities fee ¥210,000 + Keio Law journal subscription ¥8,000 + health mutual-aid ¥2,600 (includes a ¥100 one-time registration).
